text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I, with Buena Vista...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Victoire Pisa, however,

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Buena
text_block_list.text:
Having received an invitation,
I have decided to embark on an expedition to Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Indeed. Victoire Pisa wasn't the only one
who received an invitation to Dubai!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd be running in Dubai with Pisa-san,
whom I battled alongside in the Arima Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy, my heart hasn't stopped fluttering ever since I found out♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "I'm so happy too, and it's so reassuring...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us bring great inspiration once more,
as representatives of Japan's Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Everyone, please lend me your support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their announcement accepting the invitation
sparked immense hype and anticipation among the public.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "So that we can head to Dubai with no regrets, I want to do my best in today's Nakayama Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock-knock!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey~.
It's Transcend~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one poking her head out was Transcend—an Umamusume currently active in the Twinkle Series, known for her love of subculture and wealth of information.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Currently riding a 2-race GⅠ winning streak. Her talent is drawing huge attention right now, but her main stage is dirt. Her presence here came as a bit of a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to drop in out of nowhere! I came to watch today,
so I bought some refreshments on the way.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"They're donuts, but do you like them?
I just picked them on a whim."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, how lovely.
I'll gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, Tran-san, you're mainly active on dirt, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Why are you watching the turf Nakayama Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Aha, just had to call me out on that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's no big reason, really.
Well... you'll find out soon enough!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you right before the big race!
Glad to see you're in high spirits! Well, good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
They left like a sudden storm, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: What could she mean by "you'll see right away"...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden possibility crosses my mind.
...But it's almost time to head into the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It would be best to have her focus on the Nakayama Kinen for now."
choice_data_list: Let's talk later. Right now, it's time for the Nakayama Kinen.
Let's talk later. Right now, focus on the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ah..., that's true.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Pisa!"
"Congrats on Dubai!"
"We're cheering you on with all we've got today too!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...So many cheers.
There are even more now than at the Arima Kinen.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Beyond this lies the world.
All so I can weave an even greater circle...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
…………
Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To live up to expectations, it all begins at the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will weave a strong, unbroken bond...!
